reviews.author: Mommy Dragon
reviews.text:
Teochew dishes here are thoughtfully prepared and intricately put together. Visualise:

Dinner menu

1. Seafood soup steamed for hours in a winter melon gourd until the melon is soft ( advanced order needed).

2. Sweet Soy Cod Fish (without bones) served with a thin sheet of Cheong Fun.

3. Biting into a hand made spongy Longevity Bun the size of a fist.

Highly recommended to make reservations 2 weeks to 1 month in advance, especially if you are eyeing one of its private rooms.

Lunch menu

Less oily and very delicious and refined looking dim sum. The fried turnip cake is slightly crisped  on the outside and very soft and flavourful.  Pan fried black pepper duck bun is another killer. I have not tasted black pepper duck buns this good. Stewed Teo chew duck and tofu and Or Ni dessert are the restaurant's signature items. They stand out too. This post shouts out the good but not yet famous, and the good and famous.

Book 1 week ahead if you are planning a weekend dim sum lunch with your friends or extended family.

reviews.author: Michelin Inspector
reviews.text: I am a Teochew and came here because of the authentic Teochew food! We had the delicious bamboo clams and the best dish of the night was the braised Teochew duck 🦆 reserve for a nice quiet spot to celebrate with the family.

reviews.author: Jeremy Khoo
reviews.text: Celebrated Kong Kong’s birthday here last weekend with the family. For a Saturday morning it was completely empty so we had the restaurant all to ourselves. We ordered a range of timsum, braised duck, truffle beef cubes and of course birthday noodles. All were excellent, especially the melt in your mouth beef cubes and tender duck slices. Service was also exceptional and the staff waited on us hand and foot and even gave us a tour of the function rooms for future visits. Will definitely come again for dinner one day.

reviews.author: Elna Tan
reviews.text: Amazing food here, absolutely love the tofu in the braised duck, the thinly sliced squid with tanghoon is just out of the world with its texture and familiar (bamboo clam dish), the crunch of the oyster omelette is seriously脆香到一個不行！ the teochew style fish is truly perfect with the freshness and seasoning.

reviews.author: PJK
reviews.text:
Ying at SICC is a fantastic addition to the club’s dining scene. The setting is elegant and comfortable, making it a perfect spot for a refined lunch or a quiet dinner.
The menu offers an excellent range of authentic Teochew specialties and Cantonese dim sum. The braised duck is a standout, perfectly tender and full of flavour, as is the signature Orh Nee for dessert. Service is consistently polished and attentive, reflecting the high standards of the club. A top tier choice for high quality Chinese cuisine in a beautiful, relaxed setting.

places.name: Ju Shin Jung Seletar CC
places.address: 101 Seletar Club Rd, Level 2 Country Club Singapore 798273

reviews.author: jared Lee
reviews.text: Generous serving of standard korean side dishes, bbq marinated chicken is very well done and potato pancake is crispy with lots of cheese sandwiched in the layers. Definitely recommend to anyone in the area and would come back again. Location is well ventilated with not much residual smell after having the bbq

reviews.author: Lachesis Tang
reviews.text: I’ve visited several times, and Mina has always provided excellent and professional service. She is very friendly, helpful and attentive. Her wagyu beef is always cooked perfectly and tastes amazing! Really appreciate her great service every time. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Honestbee
reviews.text: Dined at Alexandra road outlet several times but it has closed and relocated to Seletar CC. The ginseng chicken soup is good; can refill the soup once for free. Banchan were good

reviews.author: nigel tan
reviews.text:
Had a great dining experience here. We came as a big group of 16, and despite it being peak hours and the restaurant being busy, the staff were attentive, friendly and did their best to make sure everyone was well taken care of. The food was great as well.

Shoutout to Zeff and team for their excellent service. Zeff was attentive, approachable and quick to respond to our needs. Service was swift, and we really appreciated his effort in taking care of our group.

Kudos to the entire team. Overall, food and service were top notch. Definitely worth coming back.

reviews.author: Clive
reviews.text: Random find for a rainy Friday night. Found this and headed over. No disappointment. Server Mina very professional. We took the promo buffet 2 full paying adults 3rd 50%. Portion is huge, 1 round for us and we are done. Side dishes was also good.

reviews.author: Love Gng
reviews.text: Nice people deserve a review for many years I always eat my mc Donald’s here this team is the best waking up eating my breakfast here seeing people who have good vibes and helping each other make my day good. Hi to all the Jie Jie always smiling and friendly Jie Jie Jenny and all the staff and Ms Sue. Great team 👍🏽 keep it up💪🏻

reviews.author: darroz
reviews.text: This has been happening since 2024. This outlet has been scamming customers on quantity of potato pops. Even contacted them for feedback. Agreed that they will solve the issue, returned today to the same scam. Hopeless. Management does not want to look into the issue

reviews.author: youdont knowme
reviews.text: The order wasn’t made properly. I specifically requested no onions in my Fortune Prosperity Chicken burger but there were still onions!! Even the packaging has the special order label but the burger was still the original. This is unacceptable!! I had to remove the onions myself and endure the lingering taste of onion in my burger. Such bad experience!!

reviews.author: snbden bdbsbsns
reviews.text: The only outlet that always messes up my order constantly? Ive had no issues with other outlets except this one, even if you complain to management they wont do much but its expected from a fast food company. If you come here just double check your own meals before leaving because it seems like they have been hiring everyone and anyone these days

reviews.author: Fatin Nuwairah
reviews.text:
Very unpleasant start to our morning and I am still pissed so I'm getting my frustrations out through this review.

My sister needs to report to school earlier today (she already left home as I'm typing this at 6.30am and she did not eat anything aside from a biscuit), and so she requested to pre-order breakfast because no eating or drinking (even plain water) is allowed at the field trip venue. She was specifically craving McDonald's, and I had done a pre-order with this outlet before on 28 May which went smoothly then, so why not?

I pre-ordered for our breakfast to be delivered between 5.30 to 6am through Grab. I woke up to find missed calls and messages from my Grab delivery rider who, as you can see in the screenshot, informed me that the earliest delivery they can make is 7am because nothing we ordered was available.

So of course I am baffled because why does a 24/7 outlet (the ONLY 24/7 outlet in Bukit Panjang mind you; the next nearest outlet would have been Choa Chu Kang CC) not have breakfast available especially when it's stated on McDonald's website that breakfast starts from 4am? Why even ALLOW us to preorder if we were just going to have to cancel the order because it cannot be delivered at the timing we want eventhough it was given to us as an option? Was there no way for this to be communicated to me much earlier so I could have arranged to order other food instead if, based on Grab's merchant FAQs on their website, scheduled orders are already displayed and there is a live chat option for merchants to communicate with customers (then the delivery rider also didn't need to waste his time coming down)? If food is not available to be delivered within the timeframe we requested for, does that mean other people entering the restaurant with intention to eat breakfast at 4-5am also get turned away or are they left with food from the lunch/dinner menu?

It's not like this is my first time buying McDonald's from this outlet. I have seen how crowded it gets and how slow the wait for the food can be (as you can also see from previous reviews here). My family work in customer-facing jobs so we get how overwhelming it can be. We closed one eye even when we had to wait for 45 minutes plus before. This is literally a pre-order, at a timing when I wouldn't think there's an overwhelming number of people. I still feel like the restaurant could have figured out a way to reach me WAY before the scheduled timing, especially because I was awake till 2am so I could have made different meal plans if I was informed earlier. If I'm understanding my Grab delivery rider correctly and this outlet is no longer 24/7, then this information definitely NEEDS to be updated on Google Maps and delivery platform apps.

This incident has made me lose trust. The staff may read this and just pass me off as a Karen, but I am very frustrated and really needed to get this off my chest.

places.name: KFC Fairprice Hub
places.address: 1 Joo Koon Cir, #01-25/26 FairPrice Joo Koon, Singapore 629117

reviews.author: Pink 爱吃
reviews.text:
📅 02/10/2026
🍗 KFC Set Meal | Burger + Fried Chicken + Fries + Mashed Potato + Drink

😋 The fried chicken was really crispy — so satisfying to bite into. The burger was tasty too, and the fries and mashed potato completed the meal nicely. Everything tasted good. A classic comfort meal that hits the spot! 🍔🍟✨

reviews.author: Belphegor
reviews.text: Had a great experience. The food was served hot and fresh, especially the fried chicken which was crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside. The staff were friendly, and the restaurant was clean and comfortable. Service was quick, and the overall dining experience was enjoyable. Will definitely come back again!

reviews.author: Gaming Water Sheep
reviews.text:
Disappointing service and poor quality control across multiple visits at this outlet.

First, I ordered a breakfast wrap combo during the morning shift. The staff informed me the wrap was out of stock but proceeded to hand over just the hashbrown and drink. No replacement options, alternatives, or refunds were offered for the missing main item, forcing me to absorb the financial loss for an unfulfilled meal.

Second, during a separate visit, I received a Zinger burger with an unacceptably small patty—the size of two nuggets. When I brought it back to request a standard replacement, the manager on duty appeared highly annoyed, gave a silent, unhelpful attitude, and left me standing there awkwardly before finally replacing it.

While the burger was eventually exchanged, the overall customer service, attitude, and handling of out-of-stock items at this location are deeply unprofessional.

Management seriously needs to look into staff training and service standards.

reviews.author: ItzChaRoo
reviews.text: The chicken is super dry can the cola doesn’t have gas it taste like water and plus cola without the gas

reviews.author: Pei Lin
reviews.text: Had a pleasant experience at KFC Joo Koon! The staff were friendly and helpful, and my order was prepared quickly. The food was served hot and the outlet was clean and comfortable. Great place to grab a quick meal will definitely visit again!

reviews.author: Guowei
reviews.text: A nice neighborhood Indian restaurant that I frequent regularly. Returnee of good food! Though sometimes need to wait a while during busy times :)

reviews.author: Masethung Govindaraj
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful dinner experience at this Ariff restaurant in Jurong West
, and it truly deserves five stars. From the moment we walked in, the warm hospitality and inviting ambience made us feel comfortable and relaxed. The staff were attentive, knowledgeable, and happy to recommend dishes.
The food was outstanding and authentically South Indian. The dosas were perfectly crisp, the idlis were soft and fluffy, and the sambar and chutneys were rich, aromatic, and beautifully balanced in flavor. The veg and non-veg curries were cooked to perfection, with fresh ingredients and traditional spices that reminded me of home-style cooking. Every dish was served hot and well-presented.
What stood out the most was the consistency in taste and quality, along with generous portions at a very reasonable price for Singapore. The place was clean, well-organized, and had a pleasant dining atmosphere that made the dinner feel special without being overly formal.
Overall, this Ariff restaurant offers an authentic South Indian dining experience with excellent food, great service, and a welcoming vibe. Highly recommended for anyone craving delicious South Indian cuisine in Singapore. I will definitely be coming back again!

reviews.author: Traveller
reviews.text: Actually you deserved 4 or even 5 stars. I really enjoyed your food but I hate the waiting. Slow and really really slow that I have skipped going to your restaurant. Never need to wait for a table or too long to place my order but a simple breakfast of chapati, prata or thosai can make people wait up to half an hour and I have seen many others who waited and got impatient as well.

reviews.author: lontongstroong
reviews.text:
24-hr heartland prata place which is pretty popular among the locals. Sometimes go there to grab a prata supper in the weekend. The roti prata is always freshly made, warm, and crispy, served with some kind of South Indian acidic fish curry. The other meals are also generally good, for instance, the chicken kuzhambu (curry) comes with a flavorful and pretty thick gravy. Surprised they also served chilled Shams, which is a non-alcoholic malt beverage from Iran, which means this rare stuff is imported twice from Iran to Malaysia, and later across the causeway to Singapore.

The place is airy, with a lot of ceiling fans and some tables located in semi-outdoor setting.

reviews.author: rents
reviews.text: Open 24hrs, Good Food. You really can’t ask for more. Friendly service from macha and even gave me complimentary papadom. The best for me was their sambal tofu!
